chat.t: Hey

o: What?

chat.t: Oh, quick response.

o: What do you want?

chat.t: Hmm...
Is the tofu at our shop...
really that bad?
Be honest.

o: The taste is fine,
but because of a certain someone...
*cough* I just didn't really feel like eating it.

chat.t: So, the issue is the image rather than the taste, right?
Got it!

o: Got what?
You're planning to do something weird again, aren't you?

chat.t: Ugh, you're seriously exhausting.

o: Look who's talking, the one who shot at me because she was mad even though I helped her.

chat.t: Well, anyway, thanks for helping during the fight... wait, it's not like you did the fighting!

o: Instead of talking, you should practice the guitar more.

chat.t: Do you seriously want to get hit?!

lines.t:
Hearing that Kasa was plotting something, I headed to Tofu Street,
where The Great Tofu Troupe's shop is located.
Tofu Street
Why are there so many people on Tofu Street?
It's unusually rowdy today.
Ah, mic test.

Everyone!
Are you enjoying the taste of the tofu?
(Murmuring)
While you're tasting, I'll play a song!
Twang—twang—!
An unbelievably terrible guitar melody flowed from the amplifier...
Argh! What is this awful playing?!
Ugh. It's ruining the taste of the tofu...
Boo! Get off the stage!
Boo! Get off the stage!
Ah, I got swept up in the moment without realizing...
Thank you for your enthusiastic response.
And now, the next song is...
Who said you could play another song?!
Oh my god, you're killing us...!
This is actually pretty entertaining.
Skreeeech— Skreeeech—
Are you telling me to sacrifice my hearing for some tofu?!

A piece of tofu thrown from the crowd
flew straight towards Kasa's head while she was playing.
Oh, nice shot.
Should I throw one too?
Throwing  ...tofu?
Do you know how much effort went into making this tofu...

You ungrateful customers!
Only we are allowed to throw our tofu!!
I quietly put down the tofu I had picked up.

And...
Hey!!
Are you going to throw tofu at me too?
...That actually sounds fun.

Are you on my side, or their side?
Make up your mind!

Whoa, don't talk to me!
People are going to throw tofu at me too!
Argh, seriously!!!
Hmph, that's what they get for throwing our tofu.
Yeah, they should have picked a better target to throw tofu at.
Hey.  You were about to throw tofu at me too.
Do you seriously want to die?!
I was on your side when the fight started.

Sigh, whatever.
This tofu tasting performance is ruined anyway.
The vibe would've been great if it weren't for you and these punks.
What did you expect, playing like that?
Honestly, you're not very good.
What's wrong with my playing?!
Watch your mouth.
It was completely unlistenable.
Do you want to die? Seriously!
Whatever, I need to think of the next marketing strategy.

I'll let you off the hook today.
I'll call you next time, so show up.
Why should I?

Don't make me say it twice. Just show up when I tell you to.
Or else I'll—

Whoa, whoa, whoa. Put that menacing guitar away.
That wasn't made to be used as a blunt weapon.
...Sigh, whatever.

Stop messing around in weird places and just do what you're told.
It's not like it's a bad deal for you.
Hey, you're the one making a mess with a guitar.
What? You wanna say that again?!
After bickering with Kasa for a while, I returned to the Hideout.

chat.t: Hey, what are you doing right now?
This time, I'm going to make up for my past mistakes.
People just don't understand my heartfelt playing yet.

o: Stop blaming others and just practice the guitar more.

chat.t: Stop trying to get under my skin.
Anyway, meet me where I tell you to.
If things go well, I'll give you a generous share.

o: You're not going to tell me to get lost with just some free tofu, right?

chat.t: Ah, just show up!
Hey. How did this happen?
How on earth did you make it to the finals?
Did you always know how to cook?

o: I learned it at your shop.
It's not like I only went there once or twice, you know.
I had more than enough time to learn by watching.

chat.t: You didn't play some dirty trick behind my back, did you?!

o: Even if I say no, you wouldn't believe me anyway.
Well, whatever, think what you want.

chat.t: ...I'll see you in the finals.

lines.t: Tofu Street
Hearing that she would reward me, I rushed over to where Kasa called me.
I don't know what's going on, but isn't it better to have more people helping?
Where are your friends?
Those idiots don't know anything about marketing strategy.
Tch. They're such a pain to support.

...?
Aren't you the one freeloading off them?

...*cough*
Enough small talk. Now, shall we get down to business?
Hurry up and move this tofu.
No thanks.
Why should I?
Sigh, you really complain too much.

I told you I'd reward you once the job is done.
Why are you talking so much?
Do you really want to go back empty-handed after coming all this way?
I'm the idiot for coming here. Sigh.

How am I supposed to move all this alone?
Maybe I should have brought those three idiots along.

Huh?
Wait, it's super light?
What kind of tofu did you make this time?
Heh. You already noticed.
But seriously, is this even real tofu? It feels completely hollow inside.

Watch your mouth!
This is my special 'Zero-Calorie Tofu' that I worked so hard to make!
Same texture, zero guilt.
This is the slogan for Zero-Calorie Tofu.
It's so light, but it still tastes the same?
...The taste doesn't matter.
Wait, if flavor doesn't matter for food, what does?
...Do you want to go out of business?
Just shut up and listen.

First, we're holding an event. And it's called...
'The World's Greatest Tofu-Dish Competition!'
We'll host a competition with this tofu, and then we'll commercialize the winning dish!
Along with the zero-calorie craze, it'll sell like hotcakes, right? Hehe.
Then my friends will absolutely fawn over me.
...Well, that's an interesting idea.
You and I are the only ones running this event.
So, I'll give you a cut of the profits.
If you wanna make some cash, then quit your yapping and let's get to work today, yeah?
A moment later...
Greetings, everyone! Let's get the 1st Great Tofu-Dish Competition...  started!
Let's introduce the contestants who'll be showing off their cooking skills to everyone here today!

Contestant Number 1!
Huh...?
Th-Thug A...!
Kehehe...!
Contestant Number 2 is... Thug B?!
Hehehe...!
Contestant Number 3 is... wait, you...!
{player}...!
Hehehe!
Hey! What the hell are you doing up there?!

There's nothing in the rules saying the host can't participate.
So here I am.

Y-You bastard...!
Are you trying to take the prize money on top of your cut?!
Come to think of it, the other contestants are just thugs who have nothing to do with tofu cooking!
Don't tell me you rigged the contestant list too?

Hey, that's going too far.
The applicants were pretty much all thugs to begin with.
You should blame your own notoriety for causing noise pollution on Tofu Street every day.
You bastard!
Shooting me isn't a very good idea.
Do you really want to ruin the competition you worked so hard to set up?

And who knows?
Maybe I'll actually make an amazing tofu dish!

Even so...
this makes it look way too obvious that the host rigged the game!
Well, in Humanitas, this is absolutely nothing.
Even if I win, everyone will probably forget about it in a day or two.
Dammit! You're not wrong, so I can't even argue back!!
B-But still, the dishes will be judged by the citizen panel, so...

Hmph.
Things won't go exactly as you planned.

Don't worry.
I'll play fair and square too.
The finalists for the 1st Tofu-Dish Competition are...!
Contestant Number 1, Thug A!
...Number 2, Thug B!
...And Number 3...! {player}!
C-Congratulations!
Dammit! How did only those kinds of guys make it to the finals?!
I told you, there was no one else in the first place...

chat.t: The finals are going to be held today.
Are you ready?
I really don't want those thugs to take the prize money.
Actually, how did those guys even make it to the finals anyway?

o: Maybe they learned because they go in and out of the Panoticon so much, eating tofu every day.

chat.t: ...So they're just like you, then?

o: Shut up, kid.
Anyway, see you on the final stage.

chat.t: Hey, I just got released.
I won't get mad at you anymore, so don't be scared.

o: That's not why I'm avoiding you.

chat.t: Then what is it?

o: Your terrible guitar playing...

chat.t: Why you...! Where are you right now?!

lines.t: Tofu Street
The finals of the 1st Great Tofu-Dish Competition... start now!
In the finals, three contestants will compete with their tofu dishes.
The winner takes all, including the prize money, and the losers get absolutely nothing.
I'm not talking about anyone in particular...
Now, let the cooking... begin!
As the cooking started, Kasa approached with a skeptical look on her face.

Hey, seriously.
Are you really trying to win with a dish like that?
If that prize money goes into those thugs' pockets, they might use it to threaten the tofu market!

Don't worry.
They're still no match for you anyway.
I really don't want those thugs bothering us more than they already do!
Before you jump to conclusions, just look at them.

Kehehe!
I didn't know cooking could be this much fun!

Hehehe!
I'll deliver the best flavor to everyone who's looking forward to it!
Those guys are feeling the true value of tofu cooking with their entire bodies.
Do you really think guys like that would ever throw tofu around again?
We're going to teach them the true value of tofu dishes in this competition!
Hmph. That actually warms my heart a bit.
Well, as long as you don't cheat, I'll let it slide this time.
So, do your absolute best to make that tofu dish of yours!

Oh, right.
Before we start...

Just a second...!
Come over here.
Whisper, whisper...
Huh??
Well... that's not hard at all.
I'm counting on you.
A moment later...
While the cooking is underway, everyone...
The host has prepared a very special segment.
A special project featuring Humanitas's greatest guitarist...
We will now begin the guerrilla concert!
Skreeeech— Skreeeech—

Gaaah!
This horrible playing is...!
I-I can't concentrate on cooking at all!
I can't take this... U-Ugh...
Boo, get off the stage!

Hehehe.
Everything is going exactly according to plan.
I brought earplugs beforehand just so I could make Kasa play that terrible music.
Now I'm the only one who can focus on cooking.

Huh?
Wait, why is the tofu swelling up like this?
Huh? H-Hey...!
All the Zero-Calorie Tofu at the venue explodes.
Aaaaaagh!
That evening...
This is the evening news.News Anchor
Today, a product dubbed 'Bomb Tofu' nearly went into circulation without being tested by the Humanitas Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.News Anchor
The Bomb Tofu, which was marketed under the guise of 'Zero-Calorie Tofu', is known to explode when continuously exposed to a specific frequency.News Anchor
All members of the Bomb Tofu manufacturer, known as 'The Great Tofu Troupe', have been arrested and are currently under investigation.News Anchor
Moving on to our next story...News Anchor
The next day...
Phew... The weather is nice.
Yo!

Here's some Release Tofu.
This one... won't explode.
Look at you. Are you mocking me?
Hey, but who made this tofu?
These guys did.
Hehehe!
Kehehe!
You guys are...!

Yeah.
They're the victims of the Bomb Tofu, and also the ones who realized the true value of tofu.
Since the organizer was arrested, the three of us decided to split the unclaimed prize money.
Thanks to the competition you hosted, the two of us fell in love with tofu cooking.
Even though we can't be together because of your awful music.
We're going to open a shop with the prize money and run an honest business on Tofu Street, just like you guys.

That tofu you just ate is a token of our appreciation.
See you around!

Hey. Why the silence?
Are you touched?

Are you out of your mind?
Competition is already fierce enough without you letting guys like that start businesses too!
Hey, you're the one who hosted the competition, why are you blaming me...

Unbelievable, absolutely unbelievable.
You said you had a plan, so why did it end like this?!

Hey.
What did I even do wrong?!

Less than ten minutes after her release,
Kasa was locked up again for a wild shooting spree.
